items.why: Nvidia surges as Jensen Huang returns as CEO, adding more than $900bn in value, and the Nasdaq roars back on the news.
Volatility plunges as stocks rebound after the AI-driven selloff pushed major indexes into correction.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.
Riding the AI rebound as Nvidia's surge on Huang's return lifts the whole sector.

market_note: S&P futures up 5.13% and Nasdaq futures up 7.46% as the AI rout pauses.
summary: Stocks are roaring back after a steep slide, led by Nvidia on Jensen Huang returning as CEO. The Nasdaq is up 7% and the S&P 500 is rebounding 5% as buyers step back in after the AI-driven selloff pushed indexes into correction.
